feature_contract.goal: Keep the original C993 central sun raw c64 in the same live renderer pose generation before binocular world-billboard reprojection; preserve outer CABE rings, SkyGlow and original fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Exact D3A5/C993 central source and R26+HUD raw c64 lifecycle only; no outer CABE rings, generic HUD, input, FFB, DX11 or DXVK.
trace_stages: Original D3A5->C980->C993 exact central producer; unrelated CABE outer disc draws remain separate.
R23 game upload records source/shader/draw and new latched-pose generation; reset/recenter/failed BeginScene invalidates prior original c64.
Packaged R26+HUD accepts c64 only for exact centre call, same shader epoch and identical pose generation; conservative fallback preserves original game draw.
subcomponents: Bind exact central raw-WVP c64 to the pose generation during game producer upload.
Invalidate prior raw c64 upon new scene-pose generation, including failed BeginScene with no intervening Present.
Verify same call, pose, bounded draw age and shader; reject different CABE/queue/old pose before per-eye transform.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: C993's original WVP is never accepted from a different latched pose generation; only raw game uploads of same centre call can enter packaged R26 transform.
Both eyes use one same-pose original spatial WVP through existing R26 transform; only matching Quest3 evidence can prove optical single-dot placement.
Source predicate rejects previous pose, unknown epoch, switched shader and CABE rings without suppressing game Draw or changing SkyGlow.
Final SHA must pass Windows game/host/package DX9Ex Active, Domain Isolation and applicable affected source/HUD gates.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R23 ResetFrameState increments LatchedPoseEpoch but previously retained LastGameWvpWriteValid; R26's exact C993 RawWvpEvidence checked source call, shader and draw age but not the current latched pose generation.
diagnosis.root_cause: A previously captured original c64 can survive a failed BeginScene or interim scene re-latch before the next Present, allowing same-shader raw WVP reuse with a newer head pose.
alternatives_rejected: Increasing the existing 128 draw age does not prove pose generation.
Reading a live injected GPU c64 is unsafe; original c64 must be retained and bounded by the same producer and pose.
Changing outer halo or SkyGlow classifications cannot fix central-source provenance.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: C++ now stamps the original game raw c64 with LatchedPoseEpoch; R26+HUD's central-source predicate compares current epoch to recorded epoch and ResetFrameState invalidates stale c64.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Compile-time constexpr positive/negative cases and portable smoke for same epoch, relatch, reset, shader and unrelated rings/queue.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: No new eye pose transform was added; packaged R26+HUD continues existing headInverse/eyeInverse eye projections only for same-pose original c64. Optical confirmation still requires Quest3.

runtime_evidence: No matching Quest3/VDXR game and HMD test. Central lens appearance, outer rings and FPS not runtime-verified.
